Joe LaBarbera has been a drummer of choice for Woody Herman, Chuck Mangione, Bill Evans, and numerous other jazz luminaries. He recently retired from CalArts following a successful teaching career. Joe’s brothers, Pat and John, are also noted musicians in the field of jazz.
Joe was interviewed via Zoom on July 15, 2021 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive at Hamilton College. I’m very pleased to have Joe LaBarbera with me. I’ll introduce you as a drummer, composer, jazz educator, and author.
Soon-to-be. Well we’re going to talk about that. I see it looks like you’ve survived the Covid time intact. How did you keep busy?
